The '''CX-2000 holographic ghillie suit''' was a model of camouflage device produced by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 800 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The suit had integrated projectors to hide the wearer.<ref name="DC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ghillie suits are camouflage suits designed to blend in with the terrain. They are often used by military personnel, hunters, and nature photographers to conceal themselves from targets. Traditional ghillie suits are made with netting or loosely woven burlap, designed to look like leaves and twigs, optionally adding nearby foliage. More modern suits may use lighter and more breathable materials.<ref name="DC" />
